judged_text: expandable_first_post? drops the embeddable-hosts condition entirely, so the 'expand first post' behavior is no longer coupled to any configured embed source. Every topic with a topic_embed is expandable even after the admin deletes all embeddable hosts, and the rewritten test 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' passes vacuously (embed_truncate defaults false), so the original intent of the check — gating expansion on a live embed configuration — was silently removed without a compensating behavior.

adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably removes the configuration gate in `Topic#expandable_first_post?`: it changes from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). There is no replacement check against the new `EmbeddableHost` table, so with `embed_truncate` enabled any topic with `has_topic_embed?` true will be expandable regardless of whether any embeddable hosts are configured. The updated spec also doesn’t actually assert the old gating behavior: the “is false if embeddable_host is blank” case no longer sets `embed_truncate` true or stubs `has_topic_embed?`, so it can pass due to defaults, and the “with an emeddable host” context fabricates a host but the method no longer depends on it (spec/models/topic_spec.rb). Whether this is a product bug is unclear from the diff alone, but the finding correctly flags a real, diff-grounded behavioral decoupling and weakened test coverage.
